name: com.bettrails/bettrails
title: Bettrails
description: eSoccer, eBasket, esports, table tennis, eTennis and eHockey stats: H2H, players, today's matches.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Bettrails by name: eSoccer (virtual football) players with league, matches and ELO; eSoccer head-to-heads ("lost vs troy"); NBA 2K basketball players and head-to-heads; esports (League of Legends, Dota 2, CS2, VALORANT) teams, players, champions, heroes, agents, maps, tournaments, countries. Returns pages readable with read_page. Use when the exact name, league or game is unknown (a nickname can exist in several leagues).

query.description: Name or part of it, e.g. "snak", "caps", "lost vs troy".

league.description: Optional league filter. Key = league name in lowercase, without spaces or a final "League(s)"; ggleague = GG League; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read any public bettrails.com page as clean text and tables; its links (shown as [/path]) can be read too. eSoccer players, head-to-heads, today's matches and results (/hoy, /resultados), ELO ranking (/jugadores), /records; esports and basketball sections /lol, /dota, /cs2, /valorant, /basket (today, leagues, teams, players, matches with preview or result, tournaments, champions, heroes, agents, maps, countries, records). Starting points: /hoy, /lol/hoy, /dota/hoy, /cs2/hoy, /valorant/hoy, /basket/hoy, /lol/worlds. Find specific pages with search. Statistics only (no odds, no betting).

path.description: Page path or bettrails.com URL, e.g. "/valorant/hoy".

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

tools.name: alert_link
tools.description: Get a link so Bettrails notifies the user before a match starts. Kinds: esoccer_duel (league + player1 + player2: about 10 minutes before each next duel, with their head-to-head), basket_duel (league nba|euro|ggl + player1 + player2), esports_team (game + team: 1 hour before each match, then the result). The person confirms on Bettrails with a free account (created in the same step if needed); Bettrails sends the notifications.

league.description: esoccer_duel: eSoccer league key (gt, adriatic, valhalla, valkyrie, ggleague, esportsbattle, erivals, cyberlivearena, volta); basket_duel: nba, euro or ggl.

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

tools.name: esoccer_player
tools.description: Profile of an eSoccer (virtual football, EA FC) player: ELO and league ranking, win rate, draws, goals scored and conceded per match, goals per match vs the league, matches with 3, 4 or 5+ goals, current run of 3+ goal matches (or 2 or fewer), form, latest matches with clubs, frequent opponents, next match. For "how is X playing", "X stats", "is X in form", "how many goals does X score", "who does X play most", "when does X play next". Window as on Bettrails: last 6 months if at least 15 matches, else whole career. May include a free sample of member data (active streaks). Statistics only: no odds, no betting advice.

league.description: If omitted, the league where the player has played most. Key = league name in lowercase, without spaces or a final "League(s)"; ggleague = GG League; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.

tools.name: esoccer_head_to_head
tools.description: Head-to-head between two eSoccer (virtual football, EA FC) players: who wins more, draws, goals per duel vs their league, duels with 3, 4 or 5+ goals, both scored, goals per player, most common score, current streak, latest duels with clubs, next duel. For "who usually wins between X and Y", "X vs Y history", "cara a cara", "h2h", "how many goals in X vs Y", "do both usually score", "how did the last X vs Y end", "and in the last month?", "and when X plays with Real Madrid?". Filters: period, last_n, club1/club2, clubs_of_last_duel. Default window as on Bettrails: last 6 months if at least 10 duels, else full record. Statistics only: no odds, no betting advice.

player1.description: First player nickname as on Bettrails (any case).

league.description: If omitted, the league where they met most. Key = league name in lowercase, without spaces or a final "League(s)"; ggleague = GG League; volta = EsportsBattle Volta.

period.description: auto (default) = as on Bettrails; all = full record.

last_n.description: Only the latest N duels (after the period).

club1.description: Only duels where player1 used this club (partial name OK).

club2.description: Only duels where player2 used this club.

clubs_of_last_duel.description: Only duels with the same clubs as their latest meeting.

language.description: Language of the returned bettrails.com links (usually the conversation language). Default: es.
